Tour de Latte

Colorado Springs, CO · Old North End

Tour de Latte is a social and road group ride in Colorado Springs, CO. It meets every Saturday, 9:00 am, in season, starting at E Fontanero St & N Weber St. Expect about 10–25 miles, casual, 8–10 mph.

About the Tour de Latte group ride

A slow Saturday social ride that stops at a different independent coffee shop each week. Corners are posted and there is a sweep. Distance grows through the season, from about 10 miles in May to 20–25 later on.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
